children: Australian stocks look set to edge higher at the start of the new trading week. ASX futures are up by 0.2% ahead of Monday's open, suggesting the S&P/ASX 200 will continue its strong recent momentum. The benchmark index is up by 2.6% over the past two weeks, with market pricing suggesting that most traders think the Reserve Bank of Australia has finished raising interest rates. Ahead of the open, ANZ reported a 10% rise in annual profit and increased provisions against potential bad debts. Dyno Nobel returned to annual profit and said it expects a further increase in earnings from its explosives business in the year ahead. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
